responsibility: Defines the public interface for gm2’s built-in `SYSTEM` module entities. It exports the canonical symbols for SYSTEM types and pseudo-functions/procedures such as `WORD`, `BYTE`, `ADDRESS`, `ADR`, `TSIZE`, casts, shifts, rotates, and throw support, along with queries for min/max bounds, constant-expression legality, generic `INTEGER[n]`/`CARDINAL[n]`/`WORD[n]`/`REAL[n]`/`SET[n]`/`COMPLEX[n]` families, and type-size compatibility tests used throughout semantic analysis.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration-side companion of M2System.mod: it only publishes the SYSTEM module’s exported symbol IDs and query routines for other frontend code to call, rather than creating those builtin symbols or mapping them to GCC backend types.
